key_insight: A standardized time-lapse embryo database plus a gradient boosting fusion model improved blastocyst outcome prediction by combining zygote morphokinetics with conventional embryo assessment.
clinical_relevance: This approach may help IVF labs integrate time-series imaging and routine grading into more informative, reproducible embryo selection workflows.
method: Built a standardized database of 631 2PN zygotes from 218 IVF cycles.
Extracted 84 zygote morphokinetic features from EmbryoScope time-lapse sequences and 8 conventional embryo assessment features.
Trained a LightGBM ensemble with feature selection and nested five-fold cross-validation to predict blastocyst outcome.
evidence_signal: In ablation testing, the full fusion model achieved AUC 0.78, outperforming morphokinetics-only (0.71) and conventional-only (0.65) models.
watch_item: The model was developed at a single hospital with a moderate sample size, so broader validation is needed before routine deployment.
paper_title: Construction of a Standardized Time-Lapse Imaging Database and a Gradient Boosting Ensemble Framework for Integrating Zygote Morphokinetic Parameters with Conventional Embryo Assessment
